lines.en: I wander the road with a sack on my back.
These short legs do not go fast.

lines.zh: 路上有什么，我就捡什么。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the road, I pick up.

lines.zh: 金币在袋子里碰得叮响。
lines.en: Coins clink in the sack.
I do not enter other people's villages.
I need a hole before sunset.
The grass is taller than me; I walk well in it.
I glance three times a step, wary of being followed.

lines.zh: 脚上裹着破布，走起来软。
lines.en: Rags wrap my feet, soft on the path.
I have walked this road many times.
Someone ahead; I slow down.
My nose moves before my feet.
I squat behind a rock counting coins.
This one has a notch.
And three more over there.
I cinch the sack shut.
I listen to every sound on the road.
If someone comes, I stand.
I put my ear to the soil.
Footsteps far off, heavy ones.
Not goblins.
I gather my things to move on.
I hear coins on you.
Do not hide them; I can hear.

lines.zh: 你手里那个袋子鼓鼓的。
lines.en: That bag in your hand is fat.
I do not rob; I trade.
Show me what you have.
I have better here.
Those boots are decent.
But I do not trade for boots.
What are you smiling at?
Is my face funny to you?
I yelp and give half a step.
As long as the bag's here, I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我按着腰，血从指缝出来。
lines.en: I clutch my side; blood seeps between my fingers.
You really did strike.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，牙都露出来。
lines.en: I hiss and bare my teeth.
Hit me if you must, not the sack.

lines.zh: 我腿上挨了一下，走路就瘸。
lines.en: A hit on the leg makes me limp.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我把包抱紧了。
lines.en: One hit lands; I clutch my pack tighter.
Old goblin bones are hard.
I can still run.
I am not short of food.
But this one is tradeable.
What will you give?
Mushrooms I like best.
How many coins do you have left?
I open the sack out flat.
Everything in here is good.
Do not help yourself.
Take this; that is enough.
Bring more next time.
You stepped on my sack.
Do not crush what is inside.
I step back and shield my waist.
You are a head taller than me.
That is nothing special.
The road is busy; crowding happens.
Let me through.
Move aside; I still have a road ahead.
I move to the roadside.
And do not stand too close.
With a life like mine, no.
First I must save enough coin.
I have a sack to watch; I cannot leave.
Do not ask me that.

lines.zh: 哥布林的婚事要用金子算。
lines.en: Goblin marriages are counted in gold.

lines.zh: 我连一顶像样的帽子都没有。
lines.en: I do not even own a decent hat.

lines.zh: 我只有一袋金币，没有家。
lines.en: I have a bag of coins, no family.
You should be about your business.

lines.zh: 我连个能坐的屋子都没有。
lines.en: I do not even have a room to sit in.
This sack is all I own.
This one on the ground is mine.
Whoever dropped it will not return.
I blow the dust off it.
This one is good metal.
Gold? Let me bite it first.
Something else glints ahead.
I keep an eye on you while I stoop.
Do not try anything while I am bent over.
I pick it up and go.
That is no small deal.
Your hand went to your belt.
I see it quite distinctly.
I do not love a fight, and do not fear one.
The knife is behind my hip.
I have friends in this stretch.
You picked the wrong traveller.
You have drawn that blade.
Then I take it you mean to fight.
I shift half a block backward.
Everyone on this road knows me.
If I cannot win, I run.
Plenty cannot keep up with me.
You are a little faster than them.
Only a little, though.

lines.zh: 我和这路上的人早有约定。
lines.en: I have an understanding with the folk here.

lines.zh: 你动了他们的人，就得算账。
lines.en: You wronged their people; that must be settled.
I circle with you.
You are taller, but your feet are slow.
There are many stones on this road.
I know them all.
Every stone you step on shifts.
I wait.

lines.zh: 我一边闪一边看你的脚。
lines.en: I dodge and watch your feet.
Feet betray a man before hands do.
Those boots have been through mud.
They will slip on stone.

lines.zh: 我就站在这块石头后面。
lines.en: I stand behind this stone.
You go left and I go right.
Around behind you — the coins are mine.
I have used this for twenty years.
You do not turn fast enough.
I wait for you to pant.
There it is.
Your steps have come apart.
No one comes along this road.
I am in no hurry either.

lines.zh: 我贴着地扑过去，抓你的腿。
lines.en: I lunge low and rake your leg.
The knife is short, but quick.
I circle to your flank and bite.

lines.zh: 你挡住上面，我就走下面。
lines.en: You guard high; I go low.
I yank the strap of your bag.
And your grip comes loose.
I hop back and come in again.
Where's the gold? No gold, no talk.
I aim for it.

lines.zh: 喊一声，附近的人就来了。
lines.en: One shout and the ones nearby will come.
I drive my shoulder into your waist.
I cut the strap of your bag.
Everything spills across the ground.
I bite the hand that holds your sword.
There is no armor on your hands.
These are the places I look for.
The knife slashes your calf.
No coins given. You're not leaving.
I am short, so you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 这一下是我攒了三年的。
lines.en: I have saved this one three years.

lines.zh: 我从路边的草里钻出来。
lines.en: I come out of the roadside grass.
My sack shows first.
The road is quiet today.
I should find somewhere to rest.
It is getting late.
Someone has lit a fire nearby.
I will not join them.

lines.zh: 我只想安安稳稳走完这段。
lines.en: I only want to walk this stretch in peace.
There are not many coins in my pocket.
Enough to live, though.
I have come this road several times.

lines.zh: 袋子里的东西换了一半。
lines.en: Half the sack has been traded.

lines.zh: 袖子着了火，我在地上打滚。
lines.en: My sleeve catches; I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，袋子开了口。
lines.en: I slide down the bank and the sack spills.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我乱抓着草。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I claw at the grass.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我和袋子一起掀飞。
lines.en: The blast throws me and the sack together.
An arrow pierces my shoulder.
Gold for me, a decoy for you.

lines.zh: 饿了两天，我连路都走不动。
lines.en: Two days hungry and I cannot walk.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，毛都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and singes my hair.
The road beneath me is gone.
